title: Make the file-link-open test buffer keep written spaces the way xterm does
notes: src/file-link-open.test.ts:24 models xterm's trim as trimEnd(), stripping spaces a program wrote. xterm keeps those. Cost: removing .trimEnd() from bufferLine leaves every visibleLinks test green, which is how the bug fixed in #79 went unseen. Fix: return the row as written whatever the flag, as wrapped-links.test.ts does after #79. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/80 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/79#discussion_r4348398931

comments.body: PR #142: mock returns rows as written; new visibleLinks test fails without bufferLine's trimEnd.
